standards.page: source-reviewed, full traveler and fishing intent, relevant county/state-park links, rights-cleared location photo, no duplicated filler
standards.fieldPhoto: genuine in-situ photographer capture with documented copyright ownership or commercial reuse permission; do not label Wikimedia/USACE/NASA as TexasDefined-original
standards.ownerAccess: facilities and closure statuses checked with operators; TPWD inventory alone is historic reference
standards.release: canonical live 200, SSR, accessibility, photo rendering, mobile, structured data, source and reciprocal links, CI green, deployed
standards.freshness: frequent for seasonal fishing, water levels, ramps and safety; at least quarterly for stable histories where appropriate
